status: requirements frozen before final validation; not an achieved uncertainty certificate
validation_domain: 1972-2100, explicit TT and UT1, WGS84 observers, smooth finite disks; no grazing-contact completeness claim
rationale: Conservative additive requirements, not fitted RMS errors. Magnitude 0.001 means 0.1 percent of solar diameter; obscuration 0.1 percentage point of disk area. Require independent maximum-phase references at the already frozen observers before comparison with model results.
conditioning: Propagate vector, clock, radius and terrestrial-model intervals through each local Jacobian or interval enclosure. Near tangency or grazing, surface/contact conditioning can diverge. An angular bound alone, including 0.01 degree, cannot certify a kilometre surface bound. Sampled comparisons cannot establish the global 1972-2100 contract.
required_evidence: Supported state/clock/frame uncertainty bounds, not merely agreement between readers of the same ephemeris
Per-case conditioning and numerical convergence, retaining horizon rows and failed frozen references
Explicit physical-mean vs catalog limb conventions; no radius fitted to output errors
Absolute independent solar contacts and maximum-phase magnitude/obscuration at three frozen observers
Independent lunar contacts with an explicit atmospheric-shadow convention
